name: atlassian_marketplace-mcp
description: Atlassian Marketplace (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, list_refunds. Ever

platform_mcp_atlassian_marketplace_email.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ATLASSIAN_MARKETPLACE_EMAIL
platform_mcp_atlassian_marketplace_email.description: Email of the Atlassian account that belongs to the Marketplace partner (vendor) with reporting access; Basic auth username (securitySchemes mpac_authed http basic in https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/rest/v2/ swagger.v3.json).

platform_mcp_atlassian_marketplace_api_t.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ATLASSIAN_MARKETPLACE_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_atlassian_marketplace_api_t.description: Atlassian API token of that account (https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens), used as the Basic auth password.

platform_mcp_atlassian_marketplace_vendo.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ATLASSIAN_MARKETPLACE_VENDOR_ID
platform_mcp_atlassian_marketplace_vendo.description: Numeric Marketplace partner (vendor) id, shown in the Marketplace partner portal URL (/manage/vendors/{vendorId}).

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no 'current user' resource: the probe reads one sales transaction of config vendor_id ('This resource requires authentication'), which proves the credentials have reporting access to that partner.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Get apps (by vendor) for config vendor_id, private listings included (includePrivate=true with the partner's credentials). `id` is the app key; status is the listing status (e.g. public, private, rejected). Pricing is not part of the app record; `status` input is not a filter and is not sent.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get app by app key (`product_id` = addonKey): name, summary, tagLine, status, lastModified, marketing and _embedded details under raw; no price.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: Get transactions (newest first) for config vendor_id, filtered by `product_id` (addon key) and `since` (startDate, YYYY-MM-DD only). `amount` is purchasePrice ('The sale price in USD'); vendorAmount (your share), saleType (new, renewal, upgrade, refund), licenseType and hosting are under raw.purchaseDetails. Refund transactions appear here too (saleType refund, negative amounts).

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: Get transactions with saleType=refund since `since` (YYYY-MM-DD). amount is the (negative) USD purchasePrice; refundReason under purchaseDetails; sale_id is the original transaction when Atlassian reports originalTransactionDetails.
